steps.name: 덱 탭은 제목으로 보이고 id 는 툴팁에
steps.js: const b=document.querySelector('#deckTabs [data-deck="tbltest"]'); return b && b.textContent.trim()==='표·글머리' && /id tbltest/.test(b.title) ? true : 'text='+(b&&b.textContent)+' title='+(b&&b.title)

steps.name: ＋ → 제목만 묻고 짧은 해시 id 로 새 덱 · 탭에 제목
steps.js: window.prompt=()=>'덱 시험 새'; document.querySelector('#deckTabs [data-deckadd]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1200)); const on=document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on'); const id=on&&on.dataset.deck; window.__newDeck=id; return on && on.textContent.trim()==='덱 시험 새' && /^[a-z][0-9a-f]{7}$/.test(id) ? true : 'on='+(on&&on.textContent)+' id='+id

steps.name: 오른쪽 클릭 메뉴: 새 덱·제목·복제·시작 덱·삭제(이름 바꾸기 없음, 줄임표 없음)
steps.js: const b=document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on'); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu',{bubbles:true,clientX:200,clientY:100})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const labels=[...document.querySelectorAll('#menu button')].map(x=>x.textContent.trim()); const ok=labels.some(l=>l.startsWith('제목 바꾸기'))&&labels.some(l=>l.startsWith('복제'))&&labels.some(l=>l==='시작 덱으로')&&labels.some(l=>l.startsWith('덱 삭제'))&&labels.includes('새 덱')&&!labels.some(l=>/이름\(id\)|…/.test(l)); document.body.click(); return ok ? true : labels.join('|')

steps.name: 시작 덱으로 → ★ 표시 · 해제 메뉴로 바뀜
steps.js: const b=document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on'); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu',{bubbles:true,clientX:200,clientY:100})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); [...document.querySelectorAll('#menu button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='시작 덱으로').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); const on=document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on'); const star=on.textContent.trim().startsWith('★'); on.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu',{bubbles:true,clientX:200,clientY:100})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const off=[...document.querySelectorAll('#menu button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim().endsWith('시작 덱 해제')); if(off) off.click(); await until(()=>star && off && !document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on').textContent.includes('★'), 3200); return star && off && !document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on').textContent.includes('★') ? true : 'star='+star+' off='+!!off

steps.name: 복제 → 새 탭 '덱 시험 새 (복사)'
steps.js: window.prompt=(m,d)=>d; const b=document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on'); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu',{bubbles:true,clientX:200,clientY:100})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); [...document.querySelectorAll('#menu button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim().startsWith('복제')).click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1200)); const on=document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on'); window.__copyDeck=on&&on.dataset.deck; return on && on.textContent.trim()==='덱 시험 새 (복사)' && on.dataset.deck!==window.__newDeck ? true : 'on='+(on&&on.textContent)

steps.name: 정리: 시험 덱 둘 삭제 · 표·글머리 탭으로
steps.js: window.confirm=()=>true; for(const id of [window.__copyDeck, window.__newDeck]){ await fetch('/api/decks',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({action:'delete',id})}); } await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); location.hash='#tbltest/1'; await until(()=>document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on') && document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on').dataset.deck==='tbltest', 4800); return document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on') && document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on').dataset.deck==='tbltest' ? true : 'on='+document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on').dataset.deck
